name: sanskrit-dictionary-lookup
description: Lookup Sanskrit dictionary headwords through the C-SALT REST API and return normalized scholarly JSON backed by shared core logic.

interface.shortDescription: Search MW and AP90 with normalized scholarly JSON output
interface.longDescription: Thin Codex wrapper around shared Sanskrit dictionary core logic that calls the C-SALT REST API for Monier-Williams and Apte 1890, then normalizes the TEI-backed payload for future plugin, MCP, and agent wrappers.
defaultPrompt: Look up a Sanskrit word in MW and AP90 and return normalized JSON.
